messages:
Maya (CSM): quick weekly check-in for Halcyon private deploy — summary below, pls react or flag blockers :eyes:
Maya (CSM): usage: steady growth, tokens +22% w/w (batching increased). No unexpected spikes in spend yet, but forecast puts them at ~89% of monthly commit by day 18.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): noted. Which routes are driving the lift? chat or embeddings?
Maya (CSM): mostly chat/generation (customer A/B tests). embeddings steady. top route: /v1/chat/generate (p95 up).
Samir (Support): ops summary: regional health —
Samir (Support): us-east-1: 99.6% uptime last 7d, intermittent TCP jitter Tue 02:10–02:45 UTC correlated with increased latencies (p95 from 140ms -> 260ms).
Samir (Support): eu-west-1: 99.98% uptime, no major incidents.
Samir (Support): ap-southeast-1: 98.3% uptime — saw repeated KMS API timeouts during key rotation window Wed 11:30–12:10 local. KMS errors caused ~1.8% of requests to fallback to hosted-key path.
oncall-bot: Incident #I-2026-347 created for ap-southeast-1 KMS timeouts, Sev3. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/I-2026-347
Lee (CS Ops): log snippet we captured: ```
2026-03-12T11:34:12Z ERROR kms: request timeout status=504 key_id=arn:.../halcyon-key
2026-03-12T11:34:13Z WARN fallback: using hosted-kms for request id=abc123
```
Maya (CSM): customer-facing status: sent note to Halcyon PM at 11:50 explaining KMS fallback and that no data was exposed. PM asked for ETA on fix and whether retries are safe.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): action items: (1) ops team to confirm whether automatic retry/backoff is in place for KMS timeouts; (2) ramp up fallback notifications to avoid 429s when fallback path saturates; (3) propose short-term patch: increase KMS client timeout and add jittered retry (2 retries) — low risk.
Samir (Support): confirmed: retries exist but backoff config is conservative (linear). I'll open a PR to switch to exponential backoff + jitter for KMS client and add one extra retry window. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Lee (CS Ops): suggested infra tweak: temporarily enable a small burst pool on Halcyon's dedicated nodes in us-east to absorb retry traffic while we fix KMS. Can enable in console, low risk.
Maya (CSM): onboarding status: Halcyon has completed SSO + service-account setup. Scheduled enablement session with product next Tue 16:00 UTC.
Maya (CSM): renewal flag: nothing urgent — but if spend trajectory continues they may hit quota limits and request earlier commit. Recommend we offer a short-term top-up credit or a pre-commit uplift to avoid throttles. Thoughts?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): agree. Offer guided capacity uplift + 2-week grace to smooth. I'll draft language.
Samir (Support): monitoring: adding a dashboard tile for KMS fallback rate and a daily digest to Halcyon's CSM.
Maya (CSM): next steps recap: @Samir PR for retries (ETA EOD tomorrow); @Lee enable small burst pool in us-east (opt-in, I'll confirm with Halcyon PM before enabling); @Jordan draft uplift offer; I'll send a customer update once we have PR + burst plan.
Lee (CS Ops): ack — will stand by for PM approval.
Samir (Support): ack.
Maya (CSM): thanks team :pray:— ping here for updates.
